output_list.reason: Address[1] transfers without checking the receiving contract has implemented the ERC20 tokenFallback function. As a result, the attacker can send more tokens to the attacker's own address via a transaction. While it is technically possible to implement the ERC20 tokenFallback function, it is good practice to implement it because every token's transfers must go through a black hole to avoid locking of tokens. There are two ways to circumvent the detection: (1) Remove or rename the tokenFallback function (2) Override transferFrom function and manually transfer value and execute tokenFallback if applicable.
